name: Tech.co

sources.title: Contact page — press@tech.co for tech press releases/news announcements; commercial@tech.co for sponsored posts; partnerships via MVF 'Become a Partner'

conditions: There is no submission form or listing — the free route is pitching press@tech.co with a genuinely newsworthy tech announcement; coverage is editorially decided and never guaranteed
Guaranteed presence requires paid routes: sponsored posts via commercial@tech.co or partnership/lead-gen via MVF Global
requirements: A real news angle — product news, funding, data, or a story relevant to Tech.co's beats (AI, cybersecurity, business software, logistics, hospitality tech)
Press contact email pitch; no form fields
preparation: A newsworthy announcement with a concrete angle (launch with traction numbers, funding, original research)
Short pitch email — subject line, 2–3 sentence story, link to press kit/site
workflow: For a paid/sponsored route, contact commercial@tech.co
For software-review/partnership coverage, apply via the MVF 'Become a Partner' link
Follow up once after ~a week if no response
watchFor: Batch 'submissionUrl' is just the contact page — there is no self-serve listing
Press inboxes are high-volume; a generic 'we launched' pitch is usually ignored
Tech.co is an MVF property — affiliate/lead-gen commercial model; editorial reviews of business software may favor partner products
Sponsored posts are labeled and cost money — don't confuse with editorial coverage
countsAsLive: A Tech.co article or review mentioning/linking the product is published at a tech.co URL
